svg.title: One event template, two synthetic draws
svg.desc: SELA seminar v10, slide 14. GroundTSSyn: Hou et al. (2026), section 5 and Appendix A.2, https://aclanthology.org/2026.findings-emnlp.229/. Figure layout adapted from Xie et al. (2025), Fig. 4, as credited in the seminar. Durations and amplitudes in the paired draws are illustrative and precede normalization.
